title: [B2 • Band 6.0] Bài 210: The Internal Clockwork: Chronobiology
passageHtml:
PASSAGE 210 (LEVEL B2 • BAND 6.0)

The Internal Clockwork: Chronobiology and the Modern Workplace

Paragraph A. Throughout human evolution, human biology operated strictly according to the daily cycle of sunlight and darkness. Virtually every cell within the body runs on a genetically coded twenty-four-hour circadian clock regulating core body temperature, digestive enzymes, immune responses, and cortisol levels. At the top of this system sits the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN), a tiny cluster of twenty thousand neurons inside the hypothalamus. Serving as a master pacemaker, the SCN coordinates cellular clocks across distant organs through neural and hormonal messages.

Paragraph B. Modern electric lighting and twenty-four-hour economies have fractured this ancient alignment. Millions of employees must perform demanding tasks during hours when their physiology expects sleep. Chronobiologists identify three main circadian types, or 'chronotypes': morning 'larks', intermediate types, and evening 'owls'. Crucially, an individual's chronotype stems largely from inherited variations in the PER and CRY clock gene families and cannot simply be altered through personal willpower or moral discipline.

Paragraph C. When fixed work schedules conflict fundamentally with an employee's biological clock, the resulting strain is known as 'social jetlag'. In an epidemiological survey covering more than fifty thousand European workers, chronobiologist Dr. Till Roenneberg found that over seventy percent suffer at least two hours of social jetlag each workday. Roenneberg explains that forcing an evening chronotype out of bed at 6:00 AM is biologically identical to making a morning type work through midnight: the body temperature remains depressed while the brain stays flooded with melatonin.

Paragraph D. The safety costs of circadian mismatch are severe in high-risk industries such as healthcare, aviation, chemical plants, and nuclear power. At 4:00 AM, human alertness drops to its daily minimum: reaction times slow by up to fifty percent, attention lapses multiply, and human operational error triples. Historical forensic reviews reveal that major twentieth-century disasters—including the Chernobyl nuclear accident and the Exxon Valdez tanker grounding—occurred during early-morning shifts when exhausted operators misread critical instruments. Over decades, chronic night-shift labour also elevates risks of Type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and gastrointestinal cancers.

Paragraph E. To address this occupational crisis, progressive companies are abandoning uniform nine-to-five timetables in favour of chronotype-based scheduling. In a corporate trial across three German manufacturing plants, workers underwent genetic testing and were assigned early, standard, or late shifts matching their internal clocks. Within six months, absenteeism dropped by twenty-eight percent, workplace injuries declined dramatically, and job satisfaction rose sharply.

Paragraph F. In parallel, lighting engineers are designing dynamic circadian LED fixtures for windowless workplaces. These systems deliver cool, blue-enriched illumination during morning hours to curb daytime drowsiness, then shift gradually toward warm, amber wavelengths in the late afternoon so natural melatonin production is preserved. As firms confront rising burnout and healthcare costs, respecting the non-negotiable biology of the internal clock is emerging as a decisive workplace reform.

steps: Đoạn D: Thảm họa Chernobyl và tàu dầu Exxon Valdez xảy ra lúc rạng sáng do nhân viên mệt mỏi.

steps: Đoạn F: Đèn LED phát ánh sáng xanh buổi sáng để tỉnh táo và chuyển sang màu hổ phách ấm vào chiều muộn.

q3.text: why personal effort alone cannot permanently alter natural sleep preferences

steps: Đoạn B: Nhịp sinh học do biến thể di truyền gen PER và CRY quyết định, không đổi được bằng ý chí.

q5.text: Nuclear plant operators in the twentieth century earned higher wages than oil tanker staff.

steps: Đoạn D: Bài có nhắc cả thảm họa hạt nhân và tàu dầu nhưng không đề cập tiền lương.

q8.text: Morning blue-enriched LED lights are designed to increase melatonin levels before noon.

steps: Đoạn F: Đèn xanh buổi sáng giúp giảm buồn ngủ (ức chế buồn ngủ), còn ánh sáng ấm buổi chiều mới giúp bảo toàn melatonin.
